rules.name: combined-var-01-discovery-uat
rules.sql: SELECT tenant_id, code, template_name, created_timestamp, updated_timestamp, length(rule_data::text) AS rule_chars, rule_data::text AS rule_text FROM opera.oga_configservice_uploadrules WHERE code = 'PIPELINE CONFIG' AND template_name = 'Combined VAR' ORDER BY created_timestamp DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT tenant_id, business_unit, value_date, settlement_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table ORDER BY tenant_id, business_unit LIMIT 50

SELECT table_name, table_type FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name IN ('helper_var_accounting_report', 'var_aggregation_level_table', 'helper_var_mult_factor_view', 'var_cont_price_change_table', 'var_cont_vol_change_table', 'cloned_product_master_table', 'product_busdays_table', 'future_cont_series_table', 'option_cont_series_table', 'valuation_date_table') ORDER BY table_name

SELECT table_name, ordinal_position, column_name, data_type FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema = 'opera' AND table_name IN ('helper_var_accounting_report', 'var_aggregation_level_table', 'future_cont_series_table', 'option_cont_series_table', 'valuation_date_table') ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position

SELECT 'helper_var_accounting_report' AS table_name, count(*) AS row_count FROM opera.helper_var_accounting_report UNION ALL SELECT 'var_aggregation_level_table', count(*) FROM opera.var_aggregation_level_table UNION ALL SELECT 'helper_var_mult_factor_view', count(*) FROM opera.helper_var_mult_factor_view UNION ALL SELECT 'var_cont_price_change_table', count(*) FROM opera.var_cont_price_change_table UNION ALL SELECT 'var_cont_vol_change_table', count(*) FROM opera.var_cont_vol_change_table UNION ALL SELECT 'cloned_product_master_table', count(*) FROM opera.cloned_product_master_table UNION ALL SELECT 'product_busdays_table', count(*) FROM opera.product_busdays_table UNION ALL SELECT 'future_cont_series_table', count(*) FROM opera.future_cont_series_table UNION ALL SELECT 'option_cont_series_table', count(*) FROM opera.option_cont_series_table
